name: TextArea
description: TextArea component with label support and error handling

props.name: error
props.description: Validation error message. When provided, displays error styling (red border) and the message below the textarea

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label displayed above the textarea

props.name: id
props.description: HTML id for the textarea. Required when using label for accessibility

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Custom className for the root wrapper
